name: Thomas Grinter
why: Herald People Poll mugshot, the only photograph of him found in the digitised run; small and darkly printed but the face reads.
id_basis: People Poll runs five head shots in a row with each name block centred directly under its own photograph; the five name centres match the five photo centres to within 0.005 of the page width, so the second face is Grinter. Name matched in full and Grinter is an uncommon surname at Western in these years.

name: Shawn Peavie
why: Studio mugshot the Herald ran with its 2002 SGA election candidate profiles; the only photograph of him in the digitised run.
id_basis: Five candidate portraits run in a single column, each with its own name set in small caps directly under it; the label SHAWN PEAVIE sits under this frame and the story names the five candidates for VP of Administration in the same order.

name: Charlie Walker
why: Studio mugshot the Herald ran with its 2002 SGA election candidate profiles; smiling, well lit, the best frame of him in the digitised run.
id_basis: Five candidate portraits run in a single column, each with its own name set in small caps directly under it; the label CHARLIE WALKER sits under this frame, fourth of five, matching the story order Copeland, Johnson, Peavie, Walker, Wolfe.

name: Holly Skidmore
why: Studio portrait run beside the Herald profile of her campaign for SGA vice president of public relations; well lit and smiling.
id_basis: Two head shots on the page, one per candidate, each with the name set in bold directly beneath it; this frame carries Holly Skidmore and sits in the column of the story about her, the Rawlings frame being in his own column.

name: Aaron High
why: People Poll head shot, the only photograph of him in the digitised Herald; taken 18 months after his SGA year but clear and front-on.
id_basis: A four-across People Poll under the question about new year resolutions; each head shot carries its own quote and a bold name with class standing centred beneath it, and Aaron High is the block under the first frame.

name: Sam Stinson
why: His Herald columnist head shot, the largest and clearest photograph of him in the digitised run; taken three years before his SGA year.
id_basis: The name is set in bold directly under his own column mugshot, with commentary under it. The column tagline dates him: a freshman English major from Bowling Green in September 1998, which makes him a senior in 2001-02, the year the SGA record seats him; the Herald masthead of April 2000 also lists a Sam Stinson as online editor, matching his later SGA post of Information Technology Director. No second Sam Stinson appears anywhere in the digitised run.

name: Billy Lyons
why: Candidate mugshot from the Herald profile of his run for SGA vice president of finance; small newsprint head shot but front-on and legible.
id_basis: The name is set in bold on its own line directly beneath the single mugshot in the story headlined Lyons hoping to reach students, whose opening sentence names Beechmont senior Billy Lyons of SGA as the subject.

name: Duan Wright
why: The clearest of his two Herald mugshots; the April 1999 frame in the same run is blown out, this one is evenly lit and front-on.
id_basis: Two candidate mugshots side by side, each with the name in bold directly beneath it; this is the left frame labelled Duan Wright, and the story beside it names Duan Wright and Dwight Campbell as the SGA presidential ticket. He also appears captioned the same way in the 8 April 1999 issue, p. 6.

name: Dwight Campbell
why: Candidate mugshot from the Herald profile of the Wright-Campbell ticket; the only photograph of him in the digitised run.
id_basis: Two candidate mugshots side by side, each with the name in bold directly beneath it; this is the right frame labelled Dwight Campbell, and the story beside it names Duan Wright and Dwight Campbell as the ticket.

name: Joe Matheis
why: Candidate mugshot from the Herald report on the 1999 SGA finance race; the only clear photograph of him in the digitised run.
id_basis: Two mugshots run side by side above the story, each with the name in bold directly beneath it; the right frame is labelled Joe Matheis and the left Ryan Morrison, and the text beside them names both as candidates for SGA vice president for finance.

name: Scott Foster
why: People Poll head shot, the only photograph of anyone of that name in the digitised run; dark newsprint but the face is front-on and complete.
id_basis: Five People Poll head shots in a row; measuring the dark column bands puts the photo centres at 0.185, 0.279, 0.374, 0.470 and 0.563 of the page width and the five name blocks at 0.19, 0.284, 0.379, 0.477 and 0.560, so each name sits under its own frame and Scott Foster is the third. Caveat for the editor: the tie to the SGA member is the name plus the timeline, a Somerset junior government major in autumn 1997 being a senior when Scott Foster was sworn in At-Large on 29 Sept 1998. The Herald never photographs him in an SGA context.

name: Cory Dryden
why: People Poll head shot from inside his SGA year; small and grainy but smiling and front-on, and the only photograph of him in the digitised run.
caption_quote: Cory Dryden, sophomore from Corydon, Ind.
id_basis: Five People Poll head shots in a row, each with its quote and name block centred under its own frame; the column bands measured off the scan put the five photo blocks at 0.122-0.194, 0.208-0.272, 0.301-0.380, 0.393-0.471 and 0.484-0.564 of the page width, matching the five name blocks, and Cory Dryden is the second.

name: Jimmy Ausbrooks
why: Working photograph of him at the Lambda Society mall space, the only frame in the digitised run where he is the sole named subject and his face is visible; the other Herald frame of him is a costume shot from a drag show.
caption_quote: Franklin senior Jimmy Ausbrooks places a ribbon with the freedom stripes on it
id_basis: Single-subject caption set in bold directly beneath the photograph, and only one person appears in the frame. Timeline agrees: the Herald calls him a Franklin junior in April 1997 and a Franklin senior in October 1998, so he was on campus through the 1997-98 SGA year. Ausbrooks is a rare surname and no second Jimmy Ausbrooks appears in the digitised run.

name: Jay Sharkey
why: Action frame from inside his SGA year, the only photograph of him in the digitised run; small and he is wearing a cap, but the face is front-on and the eyes read.
caption_quote: Madisonville sophomore Jay Sharkey displays mad hops during the Sigma Alpha Epsilon
id_basis: The caption names one person only, and the frame carries one whole figure, the man in mid-air; the only other body part in shot is a leg at the bottom left corner. Sharkey is the leaping figure.

name: Brent Ditto
why: Large, sharp, well-lit face from inside his SGA year; the only photograph of him in the digitised run and by far the best-resolved frame found in this block.
caption_quote: helps Elizabethtown freshman Brent Ditto, a new member of Phi Delta Theta fraternity
id_basis: The caption describes a wheelbarrow race between two people: Louisville sophomore Dana Gillespie, a Kappa Delta, holding the legs of Brent Ditto, a Phi Delta Theta. The figure on his hands with his face to the camera is therefore Ditto; the person behind him, in the dark Kappa Delta letters shirt, is Gillespie. Elizabethtown freshman in September 1998 matches his single SGA year of 1998-99.

name: Amber Lee Mason
why: People Poll head shot taken inside her SGA year; smiling and front-on, and the only frame of her face in the digitised run.
id_basis: Five head shots in a row, each with its quote and a bold name block centred directly under its own frame; the five photo centres and the five name centres line up one to one, and Amber Mason is the fifth. Timeline agrees: a Nashville freshman in March 1998 is the 1997-98 SGA year, and the Herald calls the same Amber Mason a Nashville junior in April 2000 and lists her among Alpha Omicron Pi new members in September 1997. Caveat for the editor: the Herald prints her as Amber Mason, the archive as Amber Lee Mason; first and last name match exactly and only one Amber Mason appears in the digitised run.

name: Joshua Hampton
why: Large, sharp, front-on face looking straight at the camera; the only photograph of him in the digitised run.
caption_quote: clockwise from back left: Darren Doyle, Jonathan Hodges, Mark Whitley, Josh Hampton
id_basis: The caption gives a positional key for five band members, clockwise from back left. Five people are in the frame: a capped man with his mouth open at the back left, a capped man in glasses behind him at back centre, a bearded man at back right, a man in a checked shirt at front right and a man in a grey sweater at front left. Read clockwise from the back left that gives Doyle, Hodges, Whitley, Hampton, Lawrence, so Hampton is the front-right man in the checked shirt, the only one looking into the lens. Caveat for the editor: the tie to the SGA member is the name plus the cohort. The story calls him a Morgantown junior in January 2000, which makes him a sophomore in 1998-99, the year the archive seats Joshua Hampton, and no second Josh or Joshua Hampton appears in the digitised run.

name: Eddie Schwab
why: People Poll head shot from the year before his first SGA year; front-on and clear, and the only photograph of him in the digitised run.
id_basis: Five head shots in a row, each with its quote and a bold name block centred directly beneath its own frame; the name Eddie Schwab sits under the second frame, between Mary Ann Arnold under the first and Laura Lopez under the third. Timeline agrees: a Bowling Green freshman in January 1998 is a sophomore in 1998-99, the first of his three SGA years, and a senior by 2001-02. Schwab is a rare surname and no second Eddie Schwab appears in the digitised run.

name: Carlton Rumenier
why: The archive records this person twice, as Carlton Rumenier in the 1997-98 minutes and as Carleton Ruminer in 1998-99, so the portrait already published reached only one of the two spellings. Same photograph, no new frame.
caption_quote: Carleton Ruminer / Hometown: Evansville / Class: Sophomore / Major: Business
id_basis: Not a new identification. The archive already states in its own note on the 1998-99 vice president of finance that the surname appears as Rumenier and Rumienier in the 1997 minutes, and the Herald of 16 April 1998 printed a correction calling Carleton Ruminer a senior rather than a sophomore, so the two spellings are one man. The published frame is the candidate mugshot from the 1998 treasurer race, already in data/photos as 1998-99-carleton-ruminer.jpg.

name: William Jones
why: Candidate mugshot run with the Herald profile of his campaign for SGA president; front-on, evenly lit, and the only studio frame of him in the digitised run.
id_basis: A single mugshot inside the story, with the name set in bold directly beneath it, and the story opens on Student Government Association presidential candidate Will Jones. The tie to the archive is not the name alone: the Herald calls him a Paducah junior with 18 months in SGA Congress and a community adviser at Barnes-Campbell Hall, and SGA minutes record William Jones sworn in on 15 September 1998 as Barnes Campbell Hall representative. Same hall, same body, same months.

name: Kara Yeckering
why: Studio portrait the Herald ran with its SGA election candidate profiles; the only photograph of her in the digitised run.
id_basis: Page-wide SGA ELECTION CANDIDATES strip: three pairs, each headed by two names with two portraits stacked in that column, top then bottom in heading order. The Jones/Yeckering column heads Jones first and the top frame is of a Black man, which the same page's story confirms ('the first black student to run for SGA president in years'); the lower frame is therefore Yeckering, described in the block as 'an Owensboro senior'.

name: Derek Durbin
why: The standing headshot the Herald ran beside his commentary column; well lit, smiling, and the cleanest of the several printings of it.
caption_quote: Derek R. Durbin is a senior English major from Bowling Green
id_basis: Column mugshot with his name set beside it in bold, 'Derek Durbin / commentary', and the italic tagline under the column naming him again in full. Durbin is a rare surname at Western in these years; the corpus carries no second Derek Durbin, and Derek R. Durbin published commentary through 1997-98 and 1998-99, the years the archive records his SGA service.

name: Gabriel Fancher
why: The headshot printed with his Herald commentary column; smiling and evenly lit, and the only frame of his face in the digitised run.
id_basis: Column mugshot with his name and the word commentary set immediately beneath the frame, no other name within the block. Corroborated by a 1998 Herald caption naming 'Horse Cave junior Gabriel Fancher' at the 10k Classic, the same rare name in the same student generation.

name: Jennifer Englert
why: The headshot the Herald printed with her Commentary column; a straight, well-lit studio frame and the only photograph of her in the digitised run.
id_basis: Column mugshot with her name in bold and the word Commentary set immediately to its left, no other name in the block, and the italic editor's note under the column naming her again. She wrote for the Herald in 1997-98 and 1998 and was sworn in to SGA Congress on 26 January 1999; the surname is rare and the corpus carries no second Jennifer Englert.

name: Stacey Taylor
why: The only photograph of her found in the digitised Herald run; a night frame lit by a fire barrel, soft and grainy, but the face reads.
caption_quote: Top: Paducah junior Stacey Taylor, left, chats with Elizabethtown freshman Ashley Roberts
id_basis: The Shantytown package runs two photographs under one credit line. The caption identifies the lower frame first, then marks the second with 'Top:' and names the two people in it, giving 'left' for Taylor. The upper frame holds exactly two figures seated at a fire barrel; the left of the two is cropped here.

name: Brianne Dockins
why: The only photograph of her found in the digitised Herald; a high-contrast newsprint action frame, but the profile, eye and mouth all read.
caption_quote: Elizabethtown freshman Briana Dockins led the way for karaoke night
id_basis: The caption names four people and separates them by what they are doing: Dockins 'led the way for karaoke night' while the other three named 'applauded from the sidelines.' The photograph has one figure singing into a microphone with onlookers behind, so the singer is Dockins. The Herald prints her given name 'Briana'; the archive's roster has 'Brianne', same surname, same hall-social freshman year, 1998-99.

name: Bryan Raisor
why: People Poll head shot, the only photograph of him in the digitised Herald; front-on, smiling and evenly lit.
id_basis: A four-across People Poll; each quote and name block is centred under its own head shot. The four photo blocks centre on x=143, 306, 473 and 643 at 150 dpi and the four name blocks on x=143, 307, 474 and 645, so the third face carries the Raisor label.

name: Robert Lightning
why: People Poll head shot, front-on and evenly lit; the only photograph in the digitised run in which his face is visible.
id_basis: A five-across People Poll under the question about President Kennedy. Each quote and name block is centred under its own head shot: the five photo blocks centre on x=131, 264, 395, 526 and 657 at 150 dpi and the five name blocks on x=140, 271, 403, 533 and 657, a constant offset of about eight pixels, so the first face carries the Lightning label. He is a sophomore in the Herald of 21 August 1997 and a junior here, which matches the two years the archive seats him.

name: Sarah Leonard
why: Her own studio portrait cell from the Phi Mu chapter composite for 1997-98, the year she sat in Congress; sharp, lit and front-on.
id_basis: A sorority composite prints each name in its own panel directly under that portrait, so this is a labelled single portrait and not a grid keyed to a list. The label SARAH LEONARD sits centred beneath this oval, its OCR box running x=2369-2474 against an oval centred on x=2425 in the 3432x2523 scan. The Herald of 9 September 1997 carries a Phi Mu welcome advertisement naming Sarah Leonard among the new members, which puts a Sarah Leonard in this chapter in the same academic year the archive seats her in Congress.

src.label: WKU Archives UA1C11/105/21, Phi Mu Composite, 1998

name: Elizabeth Pemberton
why: Her own studio portrait cell from the Phi Mu chapter composite for 1999-2000, the nearest surviving portrait to her year in Congress; sharp, lit and front-on.
id_basis: A sorority composite prints each name in its own panel directly under that portrait, so this is a labelled single portrait, not a grid keyed to a list. The label ELIZABETH PEMBERTON runs x=2400-2562 in the 3597x2646 scan, centred under this oval. Caveat for the editor: the tie to the Congress member of 1998-99 is the full name plus the cohort. She is not on the 1998-99 composite, so she joined the chapter later; the Herald of 23 January 2001 lists her as Phi Mu house manager alongside the same names that appear on this board, which puts her at Western from before 1999-2000 into 2001, spanning the year the archive seats her.

src.label: WKU Archives UA1C11/105/23, Phi Mu Composite, 2000

name: Jodi Clinard-Pulley
why: Cropped from the Herald photograph of her Spirit Master ceremony; smiling, front-on and the only frame of her found in the digitised run.
caption_quote: Jodi Clinard-Pulley, a senior from Springfield, Tenn.
id_basis: The caption names three people in the frame and the frame holds exactly three: two students being congratulated by their sponsor Carl Kell, who is plainly the older man in the centre. Of the two students one is a woman and one a man, and the Herald of 17 October 2000 shows Andrea Farrior is a man - Hopkinsville senior, a stepper for the Alphas, referred to as he. Clinard-Pulley is therefore the woman on the left. The Herald also prints her with Alpha Delta Pi in February 1999.

name: Conrad Davies
why: News frame from the Herald front-page package on the campus evangelist; his face fills the right of the frame, lit and looking almost into the lens, and it is the only photograph of him in the digitised run.
caption_quote: Frankfort sophomore Conrad Davies debates his interpretation of Bible scriptures
id_basis: The caption names two men in the frame, Davies and the visiting preacher Jim Gilles. The story inside the same issue describes Gilles standing on a manhole cover in a white shirt and black suspenders waving his Bible, and the man at the left edge of the frame is in a white shirt with a dark suspender strap, mouth open, an open book held below him. That fixes Gilles as the left figure and leaves the young man on the right, the one the crowd is watching, as Davies. He is a sophomore in April 2000, which makes him a freshman in 1998-99, the year the archive records him sworn in as an At-Large member.

name: Kamaria Johnson-El
why: People Poll head shot, taken in her own SGA year; front-on, well lit and smiling, and the only photograph of her in the digitised run.
id_basis: A five-across People Poll on Black History Month figures; each quote and name block is centred under its own head shot. The name blocks centre on x=197, 326, 454, 583 and 713 at 150 dpi and the detected photo blocks on x=325, 580 and 720, so the fourth face carries the Johnson El label, within four pixels. The Herald drops the hyphen the archive keeps; she is a Nashville freshman here, in the same academic year the archive seats her.

name: Michael Hardin
why: The only labelled photograph of him in the digitised run, a People Poll head shot. The brim of his cap blacks out his eyes in the printed halftone, so the nose, mouth and jaw read but the upper face does not; offered because nothing else of him survives, and easy for an editor to drop.
id_basis: A five-across People Poll on the University Boulevard crosswalks. Each quote and name block is centred under its own head shot: the five photo blocks centre on x=117, 250, 383, 513 and 643 at 150 dpi and the first three name blocks on x=118, 252 and 385, so the first face carries the Hardin label. The printed name reads Michael Hardin at full scan resolution although the OCR makes it Herdin, and he is the only Michael Hardin in the digitised run. A Burkesville freshman in January 1997 is a sophomore in 1997-98, the year the archive seats him.
